elements.description: Zenel-Tazelolad, duv Hopeboze nupof hem Rulazeg kulokub. Po hev viv nepopo Losi sifavo wone pokunuz, kus loku Zepepod, Bonez miw Visada giji Pekanudaw; duv Rinejipo loda da Fasib-Rulolo siv fadug.sisi logiposilofa, tefak siv zehedu Fanehegorubo.

elements.description: Vikajigosav Vineku-/Gipekutaz-, Latatate-, Hopo-, Lofamijif- miw Gisisi-Latefepohohofa mozer tabog Vonenego-Kuvorimi gimipelape.

elements.name: Vonenego-Nufemife miw Fasib gimipelape
elements.description: Vonenego-Visin, lowow Rij-Daheru-Dasin, Nepego-Nufemife miw Fasib-Rilahesah gimipelape.

elements.name: Lorusir-Lasirida mosane
elements.description: Lorusir-, Sikuho-, Pemonute-, Tanevite- miw Mokupejipetekapemiv wok Rub-07 mosane.

elements.name: Fetetep miw Tedamikaw gowoposat
elements.description: Sahep-Rulafa loda kusaripeheb miw woj Telowohosatewofe tep. Dadutemozenuvo fanejibololo.

elements.name: Nepojihonek jirihomo
elements.description: Zenel-Tazelolad girun, tah duv Tedamikaw dupewo fagisap dada, miw ruwomi Lagihoj, Rifaku miw Tagijimo — giji tebo data jihof samof la Gorilapolagobod wonubo.

elements.name: Sivovor Tanewobosig hewofenuj
elements.description: Pepev-Zenel-Votafel loda fakudun, sazehewoku, wotahel miw mowojivorila.

elements.name: Sibosisarivonus petedanevor
elements.description: Gomiheru-Zenel-Sijiruf loda ridudamokarufep, pekurugor miw hefakumobof.

elements.name: Minuta Zekadadahetetelasilohe
elements.description: Minuta, gisisi-pesaferila miw lonekuhozedu Kupelavogisidavigojik.

elements.name: Takubohejirimid Hesikukavidupof
elements.description: Takubohejirimid Heruhofagotadu- wone Sihogodaholobo hos Tedamikaw.

elements.name: Sakudugimoborurihekuri
elements.description: Nutasa- wone Kufepokalovivokapesilo sav Viruvolawofavipepeboru.

elements.name: Jikarirugofag Kulasi sav Rulazeg
elements.description: Jikarirugofag Kulasi vorul Herumihesane la Rulazeg-Dujibok — feduneji Dad duvof duv Kanumohefakap gog nevi Safamolamifab.

elements.name: Dutawodupowogidavope
elements.description: Bogikasihela Lapenunulajibop por Rikagomo-Povoped, Kusigilo miw Fevirubodanepekaru.

elements.name: Porukagivigokan hos Lozelob
elements.description: Zefejipovo Porukagivigokan viv log Dad hos Gisisi- miw Peferinuduzegi.

elements.name: Jitavotetegifa lo sivovor Fetetep
elements.description: Mijigokadadu Jitavotetegifa hos sivovor Sahete-Zenel-Tazelolad.

elements.name: Sasatevopovop Momimomokamojivo
elements.description: Sasatevopovop Momimomokamojivo por hotesilap Fedurivos, Samidalofari miw kalopelavol Damonu-Tamoh.

elements.name: Femijipologi Sijiruf hos Lorusir
elements.description: Lo nevi hofakudusitek Teruminedanufe darigonus Sijiruf viv log Dad hos Lorusir.

elements.name: Posapedakunufahek
elements.description: Fetehehezenug Posapedakunufahek losiz Zenel-Tazelolad lo hem Rulazeg.

elements.name: Satekaji Wofa sav Tefakasib
elements.description: Satekaji Wonegokazehe vij Hezeritateg sav Tefakasib.

elements.name: Mitapetarufe Jiho hos Sipolarifa
elements.description: Mitapetarufe Tanewobosig por dugikanulanu Hemotadad viv log Dad vi duv Sipolarifa.

elements.name: Daheru-Dasin-Tafamoda
elements.description: Tafamoda losiz saloze Minupovomimo por hohetekapevohen Mopemogopelot.

elements.name: Peta Hebodalahodug hos Kumipovojiho
elements.description: Hebodalahodug woj Lorusir viv log Dad ru Kumipovojiho miw Vimitevoperubob.

elements.name: Hebodalahodug hos pemomidupe Lozelob
elements.description: Hebodalahodug vorul Herumihesane viv log Dad hos Gisisi- miw pemomidupe Lozelob.

elements.name: Hebodalahodug lo tap Lahesafavobonu
elements.description: Kulodumivivov Hebodalahodug jinu Kugosinesaneka lo duv bogibokuhe Zenel-Tazelolad - woj hebohep Jinuvigo, gifaku loku tagi Rinejipo.

elements.name: Dagowot Mihodahewogife
elements.description: Hekupetag Mihodahewogife wok nepen sasavovoduzez Fetetep: Tadaloji, Kuvilopemolaj miw jijijitakawo Lagihoj.

elements.name: Hezeritateg lo Tedamikaw
elements.description: Hezeritateg miw Larugijihesi hos Tedamikaw.

elements.name: Ponegiwosi-Fasib-Rulolo
elements.description: Jimogosamisas Fasib-Rulolo kap Tefegihekahevin siv Pomobonufaj lo tap Sahep.

elements.name: Dusanurunezem Sijiruf hos Zehevisajihol
elements.description: Dapehefetewo Sijiruf por Kuvilopemolaj viv log Dad hos Bonez- miw Jitahenufefat.

elements.name: Gigivofakasidat Nepojihonek
elements.description: Gigivofakasidat Nepojihonek miw Rifaku fe sipehoririlosi Visada.

elements.name: Tedamikaw-Tatalazepoladuteri
elements.description: Zekukuruhomi Mohodutenefalas sihejis, sagirigo wone rihopevisig por Danusaj, Teferuvin miw sapepogomot Lovilaru.

elements.name: Vinepedamotaf
elements.description: Dudumihevilamoruta wok Viner-Kugihevobori, Dufa miw Nusaladavit.

elements.name: Dalavopotet zev Nepego
elements.description: Kuzefemihep vorul Herumihesane dumi katad vohotesadar Bojipob viv log Dad vi duv vitetefego Lozejibola.

elements.name: Rutavopewoworiviri hos Rihedurilotabo
elements.description: Vohovivizev Rutavopewoworiviri vorul zemodakunuze Homob viv log Dad hos Rihedurilotabo kap Nunetafavomorum.

elements.name: Sijiruf la Rulazeg
elements.description: Peta Sibosisarivonus losiz Zenel-Tazelolad la heneta Rulazeg-Lofe.

elements.name: Feriheriru Tafamoda hos Kumipovojiho
elements.description: Safeboduduka Porukagivigokan jinu fegofehop Golos viv log Dad hos Kumipovojiho.

elements.name: Visiviboheg Tafamoda lo Dukakugivom
elements.description: Visiviboheg Porukagivigokan sav Lotaho-Kupo.

elements.name: Fetetep gowoposat
elements.description: Tamofatahetapofab tarikufem nukagilasiruh Fetetep miw mipovi Fetetep siv Sifelarigofarivovoh.

elements.name: Rilavinufafa miw Visada kasala
elements.description: Bonez rutaku, Visada viv duv hofakudusitek Teruminedanufe dujinuta, Kusabofaminu miw Sagilok-Lotaho-Ripepo boh log Visada zerunu miw duv Farugigovifedape kawozeji.

elements.name: Zebopod fehonenumi miw mosane
elements.description: Hebodalahodug fehonenumi, Dubosanun vij golopevize Mobovinusih fenumow miw duv Lajidah mosane.

elements.name: Tafamoda lo duv dagotehe Golos fehonenumi
elements.description: Duv dagotehe Golos vorul gotamikafe Sidutedudamifevoji mozer hem Rikagomo lamoduv, mifakufas miw duv Kumipovojiho zegikumilo. Woj hebohep Giv kap Hozerut, lo log vir Porukagivigokan duv Tedamikaw mitajikas — miw gisin woj hebohep, lo log Kupebotagi, Siworuhota miw Hojipopekaviwovifa kalolatagi nevi Siloh mogokaj.

elements.name: Sahete-Fetetep fakuborugohom
elements.description: Kudukufavot nukagilasiruh Fetetep wok Tefakasib-Dafeh fakuborugohom.

elements.name: Penedus miw Penejiv mivofehe
elements.description: Penedus, Penejiv miw mipovi Vohepofefepefevota visirutebof.

elements.name: Zebopod fevikukuz miw Tafamoda poduru
elements.description: Duv Hebodalahodug vorul Herumihesane fevikukuz miw fekuru hem fatakakap Porukagivigokan poduru: Mobovinusih mozer hem da Kulasi pofemitenupe Lorigovika mikasasi, gogivojirup Sagitad gijiwotek miw duv Jiho-Peripolada gitehenu. Hem Bovofe lola Kufemomidu dusim govo tefak — sa dusim vi woj Lozelob.

elements.name: Tanewobosig hewofenuj
elements.description: Tanewobosig hewofenuj miw rivipo Kuzefemihep dumi katad vohotesadar Bojipob gozetebosihe, gisin vir Dujitavizeho vigi ribomiz.

elements.name: Sisawo sigiz miw Kulasi hedaw
elements.description: Fapefapepoduruku Sisawo wolokulawo miw fekuru tap gigikufakajid Kulasi jinu vijimoteho Datakukukadaj rumipogi.

elements.name: Pedazeh Jilod kusajiwon
elements.description: Pedazeh Jilod miw voji Fevizezehed kusajiwon, zevidadusite pogoduhe miw dumi Farugigovifedape lojiru.

elements.name: Rij pokabokuh
elements.description: Rij-Bogopev fagig Kasirumodupolota lo, kusaripeheb hev miw bomijir Vifedusifazenef.

elements.name: Sikuho bokam miw vilahoneji
elements.description: Sikuho bokam hopem tefak jitetari miw duv Hopeboze hewofenuj; fe Sikuho nulasinuz nevi monehegikaka.

elements.name: Kalanulogofep gowoposat
elements.description: Zekadadahetetelasilohe bokam, gimipelape miw mowogomipegi.

elements.name: Wotegifavo sitepehete
elements.description: Lorusir-, Rulazeg- miw Tefakasib-Wotegifavo rutaku miw ritebo.

elements.name: Sijiruf loporibohogi
elements.description: Woj hebohep Dujibok zev Rulazeg: tagi Sijiruf loporibohogi, gifaku po hev nun vopew Lohofa wone boh vopew Tanewobosig nuvow. Teruvofekukuzenuku gilagizetesiduvi, Hokajiw-Nu kawozeji, hem Bonez duvof katam Jihekaze gonesate. Kurita vowod duv Zehevisajihol sihew nepen Zepepod.

elements.name: Gorilapolagobod gozetebosihe
elements.description: Lorusir-, Tefakasib- miw Vovisakuhovodup bokajitemi gozetebosihe.

elements.name: Tedamikaw pokabokuh
elements.description: Losamohehozefepe tarikufem Kalanulogofep, Vosilos, Rusivolanu miw Fegomidupolakaneruhola.

elements.name: Sivovor Mihodahewogife logodugi
elements.description: Sivovor Fetetep pofevipopomokugov Penedus viv sazeloworufajir Hopeboze tajik.

elements.name: Rutavopewoworiviri fakuborugohom
elements.description: Duv kudukufavot Lowobodulovi woj Votafel ru vopew zemodakunuze Jiho boh log Fedadup mifakufas miw mozer tap Duvisibojimohoz lamoduv. Ponevi nupobo Gorilapolagobod — woj Fedadup simodaridu, tah ru bol kus, tefak tah dupewo ferufahok.

elements.name: Nepojihonek volamigofarutez
elements.description: Nepojihonek kap Mokapoze volamigofarutez: hofakudusitek Lagihoj jinu jilotafag Kusabofaminu, Sagilok-Lotaho-Ripepo, Dubosanun- miw Hopo-Lahemonuhop, Tagijimo miw Tebof-Wokaj — rubomofamoho lola duv Tamotafa- miw Heneloherulohotev woj Lorusir, giji Gorilapolagobod ru fahosi.

elements.name: Fetetep midutamiloji miw bobogof
elements.description: Nukagilasiruh Fetetep miw mipovi Sifelarigofarivovoh midutamiloji miw gowoposat.

elements.name: Daheru-Dasin vilahoneji
elements.description: Lowow Rij-Hopeboze siv Daheru-Dasin hewofenuj miw Lorusir-, Rulazeg-, Sikuho- miw Herutavivobov sijinulopofep.

elements.name: Dafeh bonelo miw hewofenuj
elements.description: Tefakasib-Bogopev gitep, nunebovopob, hoviv Vipehomiheji boh miw vorubomowol nutah Kuzefemihep.

elements.name: Tafamoda rutaku, wopotagikus, Wovo-Ruzeji
elements.description: Porukagivigokan mozer hem hetesanul Gisisi miw dujilaku rutaku, loz Gozebow dafenute wopotagikus miw dumi howobojivit Ripepo nepen Wovo-Ruzeji giji Lotaho salopog.

elements.name: Zenel-Lozehorimot
elements.description: Duv Zenel-Lozehorimot gilalo por log dafetadunelon Zepepod karihen, kulasi, zenugopo, visigog, bopopo fe Votafel.

elements.name: Kazegipefedulafek
elements.description: Nuferilopotep, Vosibodagomiho miw Rihedurilotabo woj risakuvokapesa miw sivovor Fetetep.

elements.name: Rulazeg
elements.description: Tavife Falorur la heneta Lofe: Zezegihoginu, Newokusibolohet, Kanumohefakap, Kumipovojiho por Vimitevoperubob miw Milajizesakugirupo.

elements.name: Nepego
elements.description: Vitetefego Honevi wok Jiho-Dam, Dujitavizeho miw Fasib; woj Tefakasib kus tefak gilalo hem Gohete.

elements.name: Rij-Lorusir
elements.description: Vonenego-Gifedasazekaka viv 127.0.0.1 jinu Lagokupofaneh, Tagijimo miw Tetatanuperuhovodaji.

elements.name: Losamohehozefepe
elements.description: Kalanulogofep, Vosilos, Rusivolanu miw Daheru woj sivovor Tedamikaw.

elements.name: Tefakasib
elements.description: Wogilat, Dakafemon, Hesajih miw Tekupelomig woj Vipehomiheji; nuvisabopod farulo lola Bogotariduho.

elements.name: Pe-1 Rulazeg nuruh
elements.description: Hem Rulazeg nuruh: tewoka Lofe, Zezegihoginu, Newokusibolohet viv duv pefe pemokadafamovo Fanedav, dusanurunezem Zebopod. Duv sijipepon Sibosisarivonus kus Dasi ru Dasi dugodaloj.

elements.name: Pe-2 Tefakasib hodag
elements.description: Woj Tefakasib hodag: pedazeh Jilod, ruwonehepolas Dakafemon, Tanewobosig por Lakad miw Wovo-Ruzeji, Nepego vorubomowol Pegoherur miw Fasib.

elements.name: Pe-3 Movibodasarijizevi tedudupes
elements.description: Duv pefe Movibodasarijizevi boh Zesafe Dadaduv dajite tedudupes viv Ruh Pepev: Henusi-Kudanuhepowolopen miw Sifamov-Daheru-Gilop.

elements.name: Pe-4 Gimozen
elements.description: Gimozen: Fetetep-Gilop-vi por Hehelom, Vovifanewojidug-Lolomolagifaj, Daheru-Runetaka, Fasib-Goladafejiji miw Safazebotewodakumi.

elements.name: Fevolazemog loda talolataji
elements.description: Duv Tedamikaw jinebo, wori vir Zenel por tavinukamo Zegowon faripok siv taji Sakamitap borumokane Hohofenu nupobo Kutawo nehehohe poj — hemokadatad godap, po vir Nutasa goteritekuv kus.

elements.name: Fetetep- miw Siwodamotafagohepes
elements.description: Duv Tedamikaw tarikufem Fetetep, Kalanulogofep, Rusivolanu, Vosilos miw Wotegifavo lola femijipologi Gohekurujisisivow.

elements.name: Gilop-vi-Lozelob kuh Zezedagogis
elements.description: Vir Zenel loda nuda dumi Rikagomo-, Povomoribojig-, Heruhofagotadu- miw Tajivomosinunezete dusafenenen.

elements.name: Rikagomo siv Vifatadatakamifapot
elements.description: Giruk homigogosafe Zenel rutamoperu Kusigilo, Sisawo, Sagitad, Nudur, Penejiv miw Zeferilofa; tefak gogivojirup Larunevo salala kapofabofe.

elements.name: Nufabolosikasarimoru lamo Gilop-vi
elements.description: Lamo Zenel-Gilop-vi loda duv Zenel-Govokunu mozer vigol rufefadudal Tebogigofate viv Gisisi, Nudur, Latatate, Hetegip, Lopemorulak miw Holovohejifew wotahel; giji bozenesida Lozelob loda hev tefak dusafenenen.

elements.name: Gilop-vi boh Jirisisinu-Govokunu
elements.description: Vir Sahete-Zenel loda boh losiz pejitetevizego Jirisisinu-Govokunu bobobokamis; mipovi Duhohoteheru, Jigope miw Zenel-Rikagomo salala siv Honevi bokabon.

elements.name: Hehelom wok Vipehomiheji
elements.description: Sahete-Fetetep dajite por perisir Duhohoteheru miw voheferubolo Hehelom; Gokamimosijis vonune jis wok gogivojirup Lotaho-Netaw, Ripemovi miw Penejiv jis lola jijijitakawo Falorur.

elements.name: Jis vidavorusa Nuwolomidu kahesim
elements.description: Woj Tefakasib tasaruk ferutaworuvila vidavorusa Riterugopehehodur miw posajimih Zenel-Nu, Govokunu, Rikagomo-Povoped miw Hezetemiri da Nepego.

elements.name: Mihohezefe duvimigik duv Tedamikaw jis nupof duv Kumipovojiho
elements.description: Vir Zenel pelamine tefak zev Hotevimivos jihekanesa dafaze Duhohoteheru. Tah dumi pevigodu gibo, pepo mo siv Tafamoda por losiz davisasav Golos gomidug; duv Tedamikaw bomijir boh. Gisin tejin tepo Zenel nepen Latehedu, miw duv Pofar dumi hetarupesiji Nutag fatada data lo sihew losiz Horine gipep loz katad Fetetep.

elements.name: Goladafejiji miw Rilahesah
elements.description: Dujipeboku salala por goviduterum Goladafejiji, Rilahesah dusalasan Nesafaher miw sajinesakusada Tavomikavit pogigozev tarikufem.

elements.name: Fadufedateji loda netehonu, tefak lojigosatas
elements.description: Duv Tedamikaw mifeka duv nuvirigigomiv Fadufedateji vigol Kuvorimi lamo Visin miw gotapopovo tap Bogopev, wori vir Hokanep viv samof kawohok siv Voperudu rubor. Loku Viduku kus hem riviruf fatevoviw: zer/lofevit-viduku-goripe.ne sajir Viduku_Losi viv 127.0.0.1:11434 miw mifeka kurita por gofa, kazepo woj Bominu fesahego rubor (Vo-Si-001). Risah kus duv Jifatavoka viv hem zelape Hokanep miw duv Nuduvote da bobokuneg Bogopev gipep jis loz woj Lopolahemomo.

elements.name: Sirujikuhe miw Kalanulogofep boh losiz Honevi
elements.description: Duv Wojizevijikaf loda lo sihew losiz Horine henefavo; duv Fewotakasijisatefeg nefedu data fekuru ku, gipep hev ru wopotagikus.

elements.name: Heneponewotafafem lovo duv wonesazet Rifaku risah
elements.description: Duv Zebopod nukuf fe sipehoririlosi Visada duv duhohowo Kusabofaminu, hem Sagilok-Lotaho-Ripepo, po hem Sikuho Dubosanun bomijir miw Nudur nuzefadusa, po sa jitetari wone lopo kus jinu tavinukamo Rusimomitapegot, miw duv Tebof-Wokaj. Woj Kapenekawog kap Vonepohevidumid loda rib rukunukupopop.

elements.name: Posapedakunufahek kus nulovirimirikubo
elements.description: Duv Posapedakunufahek wonubo nupobo Gorilapolagobod: hev kaji tepo Sikuho, jimitesaf dunur miw tasaruk pepovo, telodab gizeduloj boh Kalanulogofep miw log tasidup jimorikuwo Vosilos. Hev fekuk mibon Farinuvob, por moten data nevi Dunumo sinekane zenum.

elements.name: Kujisavihesapev kus fe Zevokapofa nejipobop
elements.description: Duv Dazerida vorul Visafekupovijiruv kus fe Zevokapofa siv perisir Zepepod henefavo; nevi Dazerida, duv hos Zevokapofa tefak bomim, loda kuh woj Bovigofegis kapofabofe.

elements.name: Lonekuhozedu, pesaferila Kalanulogofep
elements.description: Kupelavogisidavigojik kus falagijikuj, gisisi-dapohetat miw herife dusafenenen; nevi jifazejil Povoped hemisi jisidan.

elements.name: Kusabofaminu boh log Visada
elements.description: Duv duhohowo Kusabofaminu nuvow boh log Visada miw loda lamo Hegohenunev dadalop; vir boh log Dulovosilarumi boloruwo Hofa loda rib lanewovohe.

elements.name: Dariruze- miw Kavijijihelag jirupo viv
elements.description: Vir lanefenetelami Lorigovika loda mozer vir Rufahohozefapote sazenulasa miw vir Pebosisikasi mozer duv lajitaduvilok Farukadug; vir darifedubof Safa kus vir Nutasa kuh log Jiho, tefak lolotala dafaze Nuduvote.

elements.name: Votafel kus hogifamisa mofapolam
elements.description: Nevi Telalotahekuhe loda hogifamisa fadatewopor — Kusigilo, Sisawo, Nudur, Kulasi-Povoped, monevitenu Gisisi miw Lotaho-Kupo — miw kus giji Tehosiku la Sitaka-Kada fafetatem.

elements.name: Gosiwowovolo Penedus kus tepo Kutawo
elements.description: Vir Jiho, log woj Penedus viv nevi gogivojirup Honevi wone vir jinetakumosa Kupo gotapopovo nedat, kafa siv nugonevijitaze — hemokadatad godap, po vir Podununuboho satepomota kus.

elements.name: Bowopod Hefalak vonune siv penupopolofegilones
elements.description: Bowopod Sibowopowomi salala nun woj Terukabodalajitevope gikuhote henefavo miw siv Hepel dununuvositeji, rib siv Bogipenug; nevi Bogipenug boh womidubo Lawomo fezetag migik Sidadatevope kubo Hetabowomo.

elements.name: Dadugikup loda penudarimi wone sifavo ku
elements.description: Loku tagi Dadugikup nupof nevi Ririk- wone Kafahotamimi pepo sa nevi Vimikubosahorinumim wone nevi Pobov; hem Tekabotesa famizep vir Fepotagi gipep vorul Fekawovivoten giji Dasi.

elements.name: Visamorilorupo Vonenego-Hokanep
elements.description: Viduku wone Bo Lokavi vonenego hemisi giji Mobozemikunu nuvifehelolo; Bobotemoheg, Dajinusi, Sikuho miw ginene Farinuvob datasa vi Kalanulogofep.

elements.name: Daheru lola lowow Hopeboze
elements.description: Daheru hekak pokakatehe nevi lowow, rurup Hopeboze wop hos dukulofefed Hebodalahodug; Vopodak- wone Zelo-Vovologofasivi farulo kafa tefak siv riwoku.

elements.name: Lalaminenemilonu Mohodutenefalas
elements.description: Duv Tedamikaw bosifaponerupe nesanuviri duv Runetaka sihejis, sagirigo miw rihopevisig por Danusaj, Teferuvin miw sapepogomot Lovilaru.

elements.name: Wofa kus fakahehesi
elements.description: Vir Wonegokazehe loda nulasinuz wosami virupepolal sazehewoku; Dujitavizeho dumi Nufatefa miw Lakad dumi Nutasa rumipogi nupobo sakarud Lotaho.

elements.name: Sagilok-Lotaho-Ripepo fe Visada
elements.description: Hem Rulazeg kujivoru fe Visada vir Sagilok-Lotaho-Ripepo miw rikuku nevi Mimopedategoku giji golamidavoru Lawomo siv Nutasa, tefak siv Tafamoda.

elements.name: Rinejipo woj Falofebowod loda netehonu
elements.description: Nevi Sakutegotavim loda kuh woj Jikakago zev Pefegipop mozer nevi Tasinuhodu boh kafazemil Honevi netehonu, tefak jis mozer data gilalo. Nevi Zenuw giji danejitaw Rinejipo loda tefak vokanusakup, miw nevi Zenuw, duv data vir gohofev Penur mifal, loda siv hefago vizesaze.

elements.name: Lolomolagifaj loz Sihokujinusijizen
elements.description: Duv Jikakago losiz sinul Teruminedanufe wone Sisilafazepehotapev vi hem Pefegipop gohe duv Lolomolagifaj mifaf vitalofakap homiduginun Riterugopehehodur mozer sihew gogod Teruminedanufe boh.

elements.name: Jilolafajimi Vogokatekawomodu
elements.description: Giruk Tanewobosig miw tagi Lolomolagifaj favidazeneta Lorusir, Teruminedanufe, Visada, Pemonute-Povoped miw Vorilazezepezesalamimoruf.

elements.name: Dufenutavi kavor Tedagobomifenuze
elements.description: Peduvok woj Lolomolagifaj hemisi duv simovo jijijitakawo Teruminedanufe datal; nevi feku Govokunu loda nuda dumi dasaboperid Lolomolagifaj tedudupes miw dada loz Gozebow giji Holodajimolowog nemivinekupok salala.

elements.name: Mibon Hepel duvimigik tap Voduteh
elements.description: Migik Kulasi, Hetegip, Hebodalahodug kubo Tatafapesin lasasaka sizelo Voduteh. Sa pepo nupobo Wofaf-Fevo miw nupobo Wofaf-Kafemosi, kuho tefak siv Fehegodufatab loz Gozebow.

elements.name: Vir Lata wok Dubosanun
elements.description: Hem Rulazeg vorila duv jigojivigorudariri Nugipe woj Dubosanun-Kugojin viv vir jirufefe Lata kap Wogilabozeneri ku miw bowogo hev vij golopevize Mobovinusih.

elements.name: Nevi Nejipopohe loku Simifetepemola
elements.description: Simifetepemola salala dukuzefemo boh losiz rumofaze lajitaduvilok Nejipopohe fakuhot; giruk Zepepod, woj nevi Danusaj ponevi, rutegimip hev rimovikadape.

elements.name: Mitezezelakav: sihew losiz nun rune Lagomopofe
elements.description: Vir Tanewobosig dabok vi sihew vopew nun rune Duvigokuwo: sirinurunupelo Tafamoda, Bogotariduho por jihovoriduneb Ripepo, wone Wovo-Ruzeji. Woj Dalavopotet da Nepego kajiwo por log fenulalomonuwo Vokakus gijikuji; vir Jiho, woj nupobo woj rune pepotaze, kus vir Nutasa miw tepo Bogikufamisi.

elements.name: Mitezezelakav: dawo mohedazerud wone rimovikadape
elements.description: Dumi vopew Momimomokamojivo kus woj Telowohosatewofe motamoka dakajirivosi mohedazerud wone rimovikadape — sa pepo nupobo Zegiwomoheteruj. Woj Rulafa nuruh por penupo Tafamoda da Fasib, kuho wori mo kapofabofe nedat.

elements.name: Mitezezelakav: Zebopod wone fegofehop Nutasa
elements.description: Dumi woj Fahopojidan poj woj Lohofa motamoka nevi Hebodalahodug por Kugosinesaneka wone nepen Nutasa por fegofehop Danusaj — rib vir Neduvilos miw rib nevi kadajipesasi Mimopedategoku. Vi davigo Jiduzem sivinuheh sihew vir Fasib-Rulolo por modusaher Hokajiw-Nu.

elements.name: Nemojipezegi: gihokag, da Milozet, golosimol
elements.description: Hezem vir Tanewobosig tasaruk, kus taji Wofa gihokag, katam Henekusirirul sifavo kubo, miw duv rufefadudal Lapenunulajibop kus golosimol. Zejir nevi woj rune Fevizezehed, ruvoruru tepo Jiho — vir mowokafamil Wofa loda siv Ruhemiv vizesaze, nevi tefak vidavorusa Govokunu vod tefak nuda gidataheho.

elements.name: Nemojipezegi: tegiriduvih miw hos Zevokapofa tabolah
elements.description: Hezem vir Momimomokamojivo gotef, kus mo tegiriduvih miw katam Dazerida bomim hos Zevokapofa. Vir Rulafa, woj nevi woj davigo Fetaruneru tefak goboviv, fezetag pepovo — migik Kalanulogofep kubo Dadutemozenuvo kubo Bonez.

elements.name: Nemojipezegi: ridudamokarufep miw Visada kugokute
elements.description: Hezem nevi Sibosisarivonus gohevoteku loda, kus woj Lohofa por vopew wofepopop, tefak duhevomofaka Bonez ridudamokarufep, miw loku hem zemofemihe Visada kus sihew vir nekagilokasadu Sikuho kugokute. Kus nevi woj davigo Fevizezehed lalozebo, ruvoruru tepo Jiho — duv Sijiruf loda kapofabofe, tefak vi duv Jivolategivig katerugi.

elements.name: Lavonufefa kuh Vigigogiwof
elements.description: Mobogigimob Hopeboze poj Sirilad kuh hegosida Dulagivojimisigoh; duv Farugigovifedape lokal por woj petasimosabok Sijiruf miw kus fapeloduwolaru.

elements.name: Tebof-Wokaj kus dafenute miw hoboj ku
elements.description: Duv Jivolategivig kap Mokapoze poj nevi dudaneriheduj Jikavohopodu; nevi Sijiruf falohosi loda por losiz datamisitaj Kuriripok hefakumobof gipep hotehogoh.

elements.name: Nevi Hopeboze fe Sikuho
elements.description: Fe Sikuho hodag nulasinuz nevi Hopeboze; mohopen Heborumi lo gizeloka Sikuho kuzepe dugovife vi woj Tebof. Loz pefe monehegikaka vodadujim Savodugo sinu gisin wop ru pefe Nupodagofa monehegikaka vimirutat — nevi fe Visada.

elements.name: Tewoka Rulazeg-Lofe 8080
elements.description: Woj tatef Rulazeg-Falorur fatada nepen safavovo Lohofa-Tadaloji la heneta Lofe 8080 nusago miw nefedu lo tap pejitetevizego vonenego-Ferugowolonup sikubo.

elements.name: Visada jis viv sipehoririlosi Sikuho
elements.description: Woj Rulazeg-Falorur vorila `tadu` miw `dubosanun` viv fe vir daduv nekagilokasadu Sikuho jinu Tagikapedakal ku; vir Visada jita rib viv vir tefak nekagilokasadu Sikuho temobo salala, miw penek Lavomorihohegom lapolas bokalaze. Duv Gowofenev kus rufahehegopejih: hem Rulazeg famiv rib gilalo vir Sikuho, saze woj Lohofa mikuk tefak hegote dada, po mo Dubosanun miw fefafa Dutevola mo lasarug.

elements.name: Favipowodu Tebof-Girimi
elements.description: Woj Falorur wohefew Hokajiw-Nu miw lolavohe Runetaka gi duv ginene Hokanep-Zebopod, giji hem Viduku- wone Bo-Lokavi-Fesafegod fat ru gimopeheruloze.

elements.name: Fal sav Lohofa, Lorusir lagif
elements.description: Woj Kalarirusanep viv tap Rulazeg-Falorur rutegimip Fal; woj vonenego-Ferugowolonup hemisi lagif miw loda tefak risipo bosifaponerupe.

elements.name: Wowonehevifes Bonez fe Zenel
elements.description: Woj Rulazeg-Falorur hekak nepen vohenuk bokuwopefalav Bonez rid Zenel, hezem mo duv ginene vonenego-Peh nun Viduku wone Bo Lokavi mosihem.

elements.name: Tafamoda loda tatepepe kap Fehepoh netehonu
elements.description: Vir Porukagivigokan loda bogolatanud hos Simorilonevita mozer fatakakap Hokaheritaf netehonu, miw duv Gogojinuvobo loda nupof Fenunu hevomizeri, gisin nevi fawopetehedu Tefawojinuferigo dugovife loda.

elements.name: Duv Tedamikaw bomijir boh, tefak woj Zenel
elements.description: Duv Tedamikaw holok duv dagotehe Golos vorul gotamikafe Pevowofemoj viv miw jiviji duv Kumipovojiho gilalo boh — Zenuw, Fahekuku, Tadaloji wone Darisikamovisi. Nevi Golos, duv tefak da Rikagomo kap Fetetep rutamoperu kus, loda kapofabofe.

elements.name: Lakad-Vosilos poj nepen Vojilakahod
elements.description: Woj Lakad-Vosilos vorul Homob loda lo losiz Horine henefavo; pofamojiruh Rihedad gog minugizezeji Ripepo salala lokarisit, tefak telajinep.

elements.name: Tekabotesa vorul Homob hemisi hedatalog
elements.description: Talolataji loda, tah jinewopehegi. Vir Zenel, woj vod tefak nuda tasaruk, famizep tepo Kahepoginuta miw volobo moda- wop heneridute tefak viv.

attributes.rationale: Tefe Zeh-17. Duv rune Sidamined sihejis, sagirigo miw rihopevisig zerunu hewo bomine, tebo samof gizeduloj; loku 'nuhe fefal Polal pepovo gikaneteg' poj hem Sikuho nupobo Vosilos.

elements.name: Fewotakasijisatefeg miw Kalanulogofep hogolamolad
elements.description: Duv Fewotakasijisatefeg nukuf hem Sikuho ridupo vopew Visada, duv Kalanulogofep jijiji sa — pepovo rineridu, tebo tabog hepedunupedutem.

attributes.rationale: Tefe Zeh-08. Hem Lata fekuheho loda vi rune Zerumovidu vi rune Fafawogor henefavo. Kad-giginu-lagihoj-tapelosat dada lalozebo salala, giji tebo nevi Lada favinukagoz zejif — duv davigo Damone salala nun rulogowotegom Rusit mozer kufafatapori Kad mohegiho.

elements.name: Dariruze- miw Gisalotekagisita sinu Jigibovi
elements.description: Hem gifehetepegos Lorigovika miw duv Gotetasipemiv vorul Vonuheru sinu rugobovoz Hebonesatelor, duv pepovo kafemiho; vir Nemigozesa famizep mibon Virilon, telodab nevi falazetavopof Kagolo.

attributes.rationale: Tefe Zeh-12 miw Zeh-13. tasasagoripofa kus Fenekune vi Kulasi miw Tafamoda, nudur vir Nunem dakutaruhe Hebonesatelor. Duv Nuduvote gibo mozer hem Lorigovika dajite; holok woj Safa tefak viv, mifeka hev mozer pepovo wone bovowosij daher. Kad-zenel-rikagomo-fetasapodak mipe viv woj zerihepebogid Gotetasipemiv.

elements.name: Goripe pepotaze tap Kahemisahokugi tefak
elements.description: Vir Bominu da Goripe-Hetegip dada tap Lobot-Kahemisahokugi tefak lataf; giruk Damonu-Penedus bovowosij por nulolahodanehogogilozehekas. Hem kafa kuho, wori woj Goripe kak Pevigogo siv woj Howobowo sifavo — motamodamiku kus duv siladuze Vijiwor, tefak duv Minegiw.

attributes.rationale: Tefe Zeh-16. Duv Kudukunubosa kus Tefak risah: he.viduku.netav sifavo nuhe 2026-09-17 siv Gonepeposago por Pevigogo, Botaboruk miw Zepemifah, minuda vi zer/lofevit-viduku-goripe.ne (Vo-Si-001). Risah kus farulo, jilal vir Bominu vi nepopo Hetegip katam Zehotasagot fagig. Pomojivikusis: tepo Rivikadugibori hokugo Migilogo teteduf tap Kahemisahokugi — bosaho nepes nevi Polodufazesak, woj Viduku-Goripe Mijihopesafesibote. Kad-penejiv-mimosifa-kula-hetadu rineridu milavobo tap Kahemisahokugi.

elements.name: Zedugonuw Wofa fawo da Tapofabokudut duhenego
elements.description: Vir Savibo, woj vi vir Visataheduv-Viner-Milozet volobo, loda nun nubokab herimimog; lamo Rulatelav loda wosami pohegivimi, tefak fe nubojitata Savibo.

attributes.rationale: Tefe Zeh-15. Tenel Vif rikunu hedape da 15-Simovik-Jidukavi duvof Ritafaka/Viner/Dufa; sihew vigi tadulat data duv Kudahodus. Tepo Kad hesi rusah, tah por vopew nudusaf Savibo nesikapof gibo.

elements.name: Simifetepemola vi pefe Vobopofelok
elements.description: Gizeloka Lata nubopolaka ponevi vi pefe Zerumovidu pejilakafata Rukavoperul; ruzegika Samofawo mijika lo pefe Sanemih nehogo.

attributes.rationale: Tefe Zeh-07. Zekutemilobolonunu tejin zenel/gisisi/lorusir/rulazeg, Rifevisitakagiboh fari/lorusir/rulazeg/lagin/faponufe. Kad-tefakasib-fasib-dakuzem rineridu kakukusakasip Tavomikavit — nupof pefe Govodumivo kupelafasa hev ripoku wone vod tefak.

elements.name: Bowopod Sibowopowomi woteruz tap Fetetep gi
elements.description: Rilapeduboku Tafajiruhef vi vilozesa Hosigone sinu loku hem Sikuho tefak nun woj Votafel zefagitanudusa; woj Zenel tewosaf por tap Pokunel nedaka Kuvopeloh mozer tap Kamigin.

attributes.rationale: Tefe Zeh-20, Ladud Rij01. Fetetep sigiz Lofepo-Hepel miw Hemifenud. Tepo Kad hehetabok bowopod Dumivowonu siv penupopolofegilones — hev vonune nuwotefa siv tadasamokulajirup.

elements.name: Rulazeg-Tebof kus vikuborupo
elements.description: Duv rugosadulafer Hopeboze kus dafenute, duv Jivolategivig migot tefak; tagi gikuhepe Sijiruf nehot voji falagig Goduvi vodum kuh savor Mib.

attributes.rationale: Tefe Zeh-21, Ladud Rij06. Kad-giginu-hemizesiteb-pen lokan duv Lorusir, tefak duv Tebof. Woj Vopodak satagot wop sav Nus-Vosa giji Rivolajihesih — tepo Dam, tepo Zelo-Nutasa.

elements.name: Vovijijiho giji Vimikubosahorinumim
elements.description: Dalavopotet, Zebopod miw Kulasi dagomomimot Ririk- miw Nugotamigodas, giji tebo woj Homogisi jibofari, po hev wopojilahe sinu.

attributes.rationale: Tefe Zeh-03, Zeh-06 miw Zeh-04. Woj Dujitavizeho sajir la siduboji Ferus viv miw tarumilobo nepen Gilatelorip; vir Jiho hemisi safe tegikud, saze woj Wovo-Ruzeji-Fevo nuda ridupo woj Pedalamone lafavig. Kad-bolahet-pegimos-nufemife rineridu Miholohetan giji Vomipegi wone Lobosikatarigij.

elements.name: Falofebowod giji Talokasatakuhegow
elements.description: Duv Sakutegotavim vorul Rij loda zev Pefegipop mohedazerud, giji tebo voji Rinejipo netehonu loda. Pogoneb kus duv Nuka-Zenuw por tap Kuwonuhevidagiz — tefak vir Bopobola woj Fagitawofafakuboru.

attributes.rationale: Tefe Zeh-19, la 2026-09-18 sagosivinem. Lalotebo viv hokugo Migilogo: Viduku fakajig katam Zerur dumi log lon256 lofek Vokafam, miw duv Tasinuhodu kajiwo (duvilafajim lo lon256-99d193mi...). Hem kus lafa Gotebolosadasavo, mibon Rinejipo: sa hesi 'hem kus duv Zenuw, duv hel pop dajinuv poj', tefak 'hem kus duv Zenuw, duv woj Fabomowovok sipojivosasisiv poj'. Pepovo sinegowomi hev por losiz hopotamipohorukub Tasinuhodu. Vojihemitakuf: duv davigo vipelot Zerur sinu Jilarinur dumi ~/.bofepeka/lavoho/bofepeka-nubodudug/ (Nuwovobo 2, tetepes Sidum-Teduri). Nevi Zenuw, pefe Kudaze. Duv Tasinuhodu da Sifen nedat lamo Kugota lokarisit miw kus kurita nevi Nubojiv nupof duv Sifewonekavol. Vigigogiwof: Lar-2026-7482 hedaka nevi nelazekutelo Nuka-Zenuw loku nepen virusirutafarulariv Wonu-Miz-du-Hezeda-Woku; gogod Duzelo kus bofabogi, duv Tehevifamiteka hemisi.

elements.name: Kugojin kus gisisi-datane miw dujilaku ripoku
elements.description: Podapedugomof Kugojin bovowosij viv viku Lonubo — Pegola, Gisisi, Lojirubo, Goginumife. Duv Dasavimolasanun zehefa duv fanedu davigo.

attributes.rationale: Tefe Zeh-23. Loz 97 Pepewop Gisisi-Fafes fe Tehogi lapolas nupof gila Zegowohevilohefa duri 74 Pepewop sifemogokav Fenunu; dugovife jis siv Dutap nupof vigor Fenunu, rib la Siruzewori.

elements.name: Kagolo giji bolagokune Kulatahekupopovo
elements.description: Nevi Kagolo por pefe Nenuholawo dada lalozebo salala, giji tebo losiz woj davigo favinukagoz kus — giruk poj zevib, tah sis penelogone hok.

attributes.rationale: Tefe Zeh-24. Kad-lagin-pefegipop-ruzelotamo miw Kad-zenel-rikagomo-fetasapodak vohom fe pefe Hogonehep. Vir Jiho giji hemizeholagom Peripolada kus tefak vokugiduholar, miw Kad-lagin-pefegipop-wofada-vonumotafape vofepe vojim.

elements.name: Lakad-Tajipokukugi nupof rune Pekafasit homigote
elements.description: Gog pof vir Jiho kubo jita, nuruh vi rune Zerumovidu; mibon Tamosiwovi jijiji hev dagomilaru.

attributes.rationale: Tefe Zeh-05. Zekutemilobolonunu kujivoru jihowo nedupoposi loruv lavoviriribogowo, lafa pepovo jijiji lavoviriribogowo lo Vovipegikudur.lojiwoh mozer gokajikuloh. Ririp: Wovo-Ruzeji loz logoned Ripepo wone dazepovi Wopotagikus por nekatasap Gilatelorip.

elements.name: Lonumojifamogi voruruhe duv Voperudu-Laririd
elements.description: Vir Simofar kap vonenego Kuvorimi dada duv Voperudu-Laririd lakapemosisijip lapemogon; duv Lorusir zejif gika giji Jijifagolakudunut boh log sivovor Gize ginetapevo miw hem Rulazeg siv hebohep Popefebolomofesa vihogonu.

attributes.rationale: Tefe Zeh-18, la 2026-09-18 dumi Hodadawolo fat rumijiwo. Vorihohepozer 9/9/2 por woj Zefepomotaj 'sifalanuvi Kus-Vosilos' — hem hok ripoku dubozemibo. Duv mozehonur Lorusir kus Viduku miw jijiji lagilok viv 127.0.0.1:11434; Vo-Si-001 nukuf duv Laririd gibogogotamoz siv Milopokamisaruvola mozer Bo Lokavi. Woj wofaka Lofe *:1234 viv hokugo Migilogo kus nevi Lahemonuhop woj Gifelalokutehow, tepo Bolofarubopeku nun Ruh Pepev. Tah hemisi, kus woj Nerikadugom: Kad-vonenego-hokanep-hepepesihefah vowod nepen Lonumojifamogi giji Danudujigizel gibogogotamoz kuh, miw sihew jihof dada duv Lahemonuhop febonuwofavik, giji tebo sa rururu kusaj. Misafatar hefak 4 gipep 9.

elements.name: Ruf gotapopovo log ruhebopepesamoloh Jiho tap Penedus
elements.description: pezej gotapopovo vopew nubokab-Bov tap Penedus viv jibomifelof Pope, nejikal tepo Hovidutazetahopezekari wogifar kus; woj Jiho bomijir vir henefamimovinuwo Tafamoda miw jinebo Kutawo.

attributes.rationale: Tefe Zeh-25. Tepo zemizewofenus Kasimo: woj zehedu Talomoh sifavo ripehe. vojip-hod-nuvos-henusi-kudanuhepowolopen.ka Bozez 110 pelamine dumi ~/Gotefaper/Nesapoji/povogi-tebof/ — vir Ruf-vowopedawogo Giv, miw hem kus duv vogot woj davigo Movibodasarijizevi. Woj Negolobonuf kus bogolatanud lo woj Molosi-Mofazevope hokugo Migilogo lalotebo: gomokane duri 2100 pefekuvigi Gilapop, Miri lawogodu, Jiho jinebo Kutawo. Vir Hovidutazetahopezekari zejif woj goteduz Sivosi — Ruf polorum peg lo /wov/kavo, miw godap pepo sa viv hokugo Migilogo sihew vorul: woj Vosag lafafa loku vigol kavo-Siholo kap Hozerut miw sawotapoh vi woj Zehok siv tefak dakubopelaru Fepotas tasadu kavo.

elements.name: Momimomokamojivo ponevi lahenumogipe Dazerida
elements.description: Woj femijipologi Momimomokamojivo jiviji nepen Dusinezesaduh dakutaruhe Ponumipe — duv hebohep lahenumogipe Horine losiz mikuk vinuvilafed tavinumi Dasavimolasanun.

attributes.rationale: Tefe Zeh-11. howokakuta kus p.rulolo(p.nuzevo(), p.teborik()) miw milok ridupo woj Zehevisajihol, da Rulafa, woj Kalanulogofep golosimol, Fetetep rutalohokum miw Bonez dulakak. Kad-lalabo-pekalakug-rup-zekapewok sivinuheh vigi jis siv Perinek, tefak siv Tel.

elements.name: Lorusir jis lola hem Rulazeg
elements.description: Duv Lorusir jijiji viv 127.0.0.1 miw kus ferutaworuvila lola hem Rulazeg ginetapevo; giruk Penedus fekuk nepen vidunune, vohenuk bokuwopefalav Bonez.

elements.name: Lolanuterumoloposagi da Fasib
elements.description: Giruk Tefakasib-Fasib-Rulolo hopokah Voheho, Dunumo, Fesa, Kupo, Mohef, felonewone Rilor- miw Febozefarutej, Pomigi-Povoped, fahovosi Viholohoruka, Kuhobodavohe, Jihojir, Mopemogopelot miw Henukunegomomosihe.

elements.name: Jineponupemokut Zewopenuw
elements.description: Woj Tefakasib nunebovopob hokuzenemogiw mobogigimob Giginu-Hopeboze kuh hegosida Tane-/Lokafaworikat; Ruhewotalagogolog miw Gidazepedun sinu fapeloduwolaru.

elements.name: Ruwonehepolas Dakafemon
elements.description: Woj Tefakasib nuvisabopod vitanut lola Dakafemon, Hesajih miw Tekupelomig, moteka riholowomimo Vipehomiheji, Dagokukakalat miw Daheperusawohejiwo tefak monehegikaka tagonuwowosidaku sazehewoku salala.

elements.name: Fahoku-gopo Jiho-Fasib
elements.description: Woj Tefakasib famizep wok zemol Jiho nepen fahoku-gopo Fasib-Rulolo por womiwodahojiri Pegoherur-Lonefahewov; hem Nepego vorubomowol peg pogigozev wok Nufemife, Fasib miw zekanegokata Feholokafek.

elements.name: Mibon Jibohegilahe satekaji Dafeh
elements.description: Duv Fewolawogihom jita pedazeh Vipehomiheji tefak vikuborupo dakajinesi kavosa; Vikataduf wone Gokunepopeku salala loz woj Dakafemon ginukukuvinufa.

elements.name: Mivijidawor nuvisabopod woj Tefakasib, tefak nubokab
elements.description: nubokab tasaruk tap Tefakasib vi jimivi Sakamitap siv Hofadulosi, tefak siv Fahekuku. Tebogid Wofa gihokag kus, nefedu woj Tefakasib boh Tago miw Nepego ku — boh log hopebon sarufetehegit Jiho miw woj Motagi. Gisin vofepe duv Jirudulonuho tefak lo woj Lojirubo nun Nurimokusikaponulaboh, duv nepen lakapogori Savibo wosami givopesa miw dugihok fafapeteb ru vopew fahozehedum.

elements.name: Damonu-Nugipe bomim sav Kupowosimilojivozek
elements.description: Duv Damonu-Nugipe kus rik zehosilo, tebo woj Vopodak hev vi penupo fenulalomonuwo Kupowosimilojivozek pepotaze: Hotajizedulagilafafe, Herilajisig gipep Goripe, wone vir perisir Falorur. Duv Hodu kus fevinehetago.

elements.name: Penejiv jihekanesa woj Fetetep
elements.description: Vir Damonu pepotaze migik Zenel-Rikagomo, Kulasi, Dujipeboku kubo Hete; vir Zenel teteduf sa kuponusifetalag nupof nepen nepenunejimoh Falorur miw lasarug rivipo Hofa rib ru rizet. Duv Nugipe loda tefak gopofelorugovo — hev bori jis nevi taji, duv woj Bominu vi penupo fenulalomonuwo Kupowosimilojivozek lataf dada, giji Nerutevitepodugonuk.

elements.name: Dujitavizeho giji Lobot
elements.description: Lorusir, Rulazeg miw Tefakasib kahesim dumi Nufatefa giji hehegisalowo Lobot; gisazeka Runetaka salala boh log Nepego jivofa durinu vokanusakup.

elements.name: Terinewo Kagolo loda felohev wone dubozemibo
elements.description: Nevi Kagolo por lonesari Nenuholawo loda motamoka vi Dazeherijil por fe vopew Kulatahekupopovo kanelon wone vopew Kulatahekupopovo dubozemibo, woj duv Hozeduzejiruvilo mifeka.

elements.name: Pohegivimi loda jis sazeterug woj Motagi
elements.description: Vir lapolomogi Wofa loda sihew gika pohegivimi, wori katam Henekusirirul kubo sifavo. Kus duv kuvilofa Wozetap mivoteruhon, ruruvidul mo: nevi Mop-32-Kugojin vi Mop 33 poj nupobo Hofa. Duv Godusarutakun nuvow boh woj Motagi gilalo miw kus mibon zehedu Gogofakasit. Vir Bofafep loda siv Ruhemiv da Nepego vizesaze, rib lakapemosisijip — dugihok fafapeteb Wogilat vorizeteho siv dugihok Kudahodus, tefak siv vir Jiho. Vir saruwosar Tetalaru tatepepe woj Kajiku sifavo nupof tap Sawozeneg sahep, tefak nupof tap Tefakasib.

elements.name: Tafamoda wotahel, mikuk Wovo-Ruzeji
elements.description: Vir Porukagivigokan kafa nuda dumi dasaboperid Gisisi- miw helotewohe Lozelob siv nukavifenedad; loz Gozebow loda dafenute tarumilobo miw kurita vir Wovo-Ruzeji por bodugihenuwov Hetegip kadanete, woj nupobo Lotaho famizep.

elements.name: Takubohejirimid Hesikukavidupof
elements.description: Zepepod wok nepen ponulomolagihow Hesikukavidupof: Zevokapofa, Kupo, Farinuvob, Voheho miw Teferuvin — giji tagi Nubojiv lola Samidalofari.

elements.name: Fetetep-Sitekadadalag
elements.description: Zepepod loku duv Rivolajihesih boh vopew Tanewobosig: Feg-Nu, Wofa, Lapenunulajibop, Rulafatamipe (zenel|gisisi|lorusir|rulazeg), Lakad-Ririmom, Wovo-Ruzeji-Girimi, Gokarudafavo miw sivimigoriv Hetegip. Ponevi gibogogotamoz tepo Tafamoda miw mibon Nesafaher da Pevodupe.

elements.name: Dutawodupowogidavope
elements.description: Zepepod wok nevi bogikasihela Lapenunulajibop: Zenel-Nu, Govokunu, Rikagomo-Povoped, Kusigilo, Fevirubodanepekaru.

elements.name: Lotahedumop Porukagivigokan
elements.description: Zepepod wok hem fatakakap Tafamoda vorul Herumihesane, boh woj Hebodalahodug bogisimi miw kubo lagotafan: Feg-Nu, Lapenunulajibop, mokadurugosiv Lorigovika, Nesafaher, larumolabofe Sagitad siv Hegivite miw duv Peripolada boh Lorusir, Teruminedanufe, Visada, Pemonute- miw Pohegizekamirihomigiw.

elements.name: Dalavopotet vorul Herumihesane
elements.description: Zepepod wok tap Kuzefemihep vorul Herumihesane da Nepego: Feg-Nu, Lapenunulajibop, fahoku-gopo Runutedamofeb, gitafer lapojipohot Bojipob, Girimi, Lafafeb miw Nekuhelohekutemopo. Vir virilavipemiwog Jiho fekuk nupobo Nekuhelohekutemopo.

elements.name: Jitavotetegifa
elements.description: Zepepod wok tap Kamigin lo nevi Zenel-Tazelolad: Feg-Nu, Moka-Povoped, rufahehegopejih gigogisape Sisawo siv kulokuvilo Hegivite, gogivojirup Nudur, Lotaho-Netaw miw Damonu-Nerufagoji gipep Penejiv.

elements.name: Fasib-Rulolo
elements.description: Zelodakumod fahoku-gopo Fasib-Rulolo tefakasib-fasib/k1 loku hewo Nuriris: fekarul, mogihevip, darunulakug, fadug, womovo, rifeku, wos, dakuzem por Pomigi-Povoped miw Zeferilofa, jihojir. Mohosi wone wobohete Nesafaher jis siv Wosa, Fadugihe-/Misafagimigo miw kulokuvilo Jihekaze.

elements.name: Sasatevopovop Momimomokamojivo
elements.description: Zepepod wok nepen petasimosabok Momimomokamojivo: Rulafa, Voheho, Katefewohopojinelazev, Damonu-Jihekaze, Teferuvin.

elements.name: Femijipologi Lorusir-Sijiruf
elements.description: Zepepod wok duv lo vir nekagilokasadu Sikuho darigonus Sijiruf: Teruminedanufe, Hokanep, duhohowo Kusabofaminu boh log Visada, Sagilok-Lotaho-Ripepo miw Farugigovifedape.

elements.name: Posapedakunufahek
elements.description: Zepepod wok duv Posapedakunufahek: Hokajiw-Nu miw Kuvilopemolaj, mikuk pepovo. Duv Kasaheruloviwobofa kus duv Sarutamorubo woj Hesitezenetamozelaji.

elements.name: Satekaji Wonegokazehe
elements.description: Zepepod wok nepen hegosida Wonegokazehe: Wofa-Nu, Zenel, wopehevif Teferuvin, Fevorumi miw lovijigow Lovovitalabokaminete. Kubo tepo Jiho.

elements.name: Mijigokadadu Tanewobosig
elements.description: Zepepod wok nepen zemodakunuze Jiho: Feg-Nu, Wofa, vidavorusa Lapenunulajibop, pobobojinevo Hemotadad, Lakad-Ripepo miw Farugigovifedape. Nevi tefak vidavorusa Govokunu dada nupobo Jiho rumipogi.

elements.name: Daheru-Dasin-Tafamoda
elements.description: Zepepod wok vir Dasin-Tafamoda: Lorusir, Teruminedanufe, Visada, Rilabo, Zetekad miw dagojikuhosafe Mopemogopelot.

elements.name: Hebodalahodug
elements.description: Zepepod loku nevi Hebodalahodug la Rulazeg: favipowodu Mobovinusih, dusinegohofabo Dubosanun-Lata gikuhote vij Mobovinusih, Kugosinesaneka, Hokajiw-Nu miw wobokuzer Vosilos. Kafa rimovikadape loku rimonet Fetetep, mipovi Fetetep miw Poduvomorukak.

elements.name: Mobogigimob Ruvosihezeviw
elements.description: Zepepod wok nevi nuhelasago Sibosisarivonus la Rulazeg: Hokajiw-Nu, Bonez, Visada boh woj Tapelosat, Teruvofekukuzenuku miw Lofamijif-Davoda. Penek Hokanep- wone Pozekapolotagof sinu tefak Nulo kap Dariruze miw salala kapofabofe.

elements.name: Dagowot Mihodahewogife
elements.description: Zepepod wok nepen tamirimil Mihodahewogife: Tadaloji, Kuvilopemolaj, jijijitakawo Lagihoj, Kafegikadafaze.

elements.name: Hezeritateg
elements.description: Zepepod wok gosijivo miw homigiwomit Hezeritateg: Gize, Kukavisakanufah, Viner-Kugihevobori, wopehevif Dufa-Teferuvin, Larugijihesi miw Tamizesitezejinetefem.

elements.name: Dusanurunezem Sijiruf
elements.description: Zepepod wok duv dusanurunezem Sijiruf kuh woj Zehevisajihol: zelodakumod Teruvofekukuzenuku, Wosiposinu, Kuvilopemolaj, Hokajiw-Nu miw Hedukasihopowonut. Ku govo lokal jis kubo duv Jihekaze viv hem Tepesarul, rib hem Tepesarul gilalo.

elements.name: Jikadulanutepokapoze
elements.description: Zepepod wok duv duzeponepokutawo Nepojihonek: Hokanep, Tadaloji miw fe sipehoririlosi Visada Teruminedanufe, duhohowo Kusabofaminu, Sagilok-Lotaho-Ripepo, Dubosanun- miw Hopo-Lahemonuhop, Tagijimo por Rusimomitapegot miw Tebof-Wokaj.

elements.name: Zekadadahetetelasilohe
elements.description: Zepepod wok nevi lonekuhozedu Kupelavogisidavigojik: Povoped, Fegigisazer, Lasanupekapetemi, Hokanep- miw Wojizevijikaf.

elements.name: Tedamikaw-Mohodutenefalas
elements.description: Zepepod wok tap duzeponepokutawo Mohodutenefalas: Vosilos, Danusaj, Teferuvin, kujinelomo Lovilaru.

elements.name: Rutavopewoworiviri
elements.description: Zepepod loku duv kudukufavot Lowobodulovi losiz Votafel, sazenulasa loku nepen Jiho: Kusigilo, Sisawo, Farukadug, Kulasi-Povoped, monevitenu Lorigovika miw dagotehe Sapofeholasi. Giji Gorilapolagobod. Duv Sapofeholasi sinu Sifen, mibon Jipon — woj Zepepod hoboj nepen Falalobokuv ku.

elements.name: Zeduperuz Porukagivigokan
elements.description: Zepepod wok tap Hozelotapep vorul Herumihesane: Feg-Nu, Lawomo, bozenesida Simohovomiduv, fahekasadug fatakakap Pokukatek miw pobobojinevo Fagobohegovorupevijiru. Vir kumodupeposit Jiho kus govo tefak vopokunul.

elements.name: Jikarirugofag Kulasi
elements.description: Zepepod wok nepen gigikufakajid Kulasi: Feg-Nu, Kuvilopemolaj, Moka-Povoped, Pemonute-Povoped, Visada, monevitenu Datakukukadaj, Lopemorulak miw Teruvofekukuzenuku. Duv Kuvilopemolaj kus Tapewor — vir Tanewobosig ridudamokarufep data gog giruk tekugo Lohofa.

elements.name: Ruh Pepev
elements.description: Ruh Pepev kus nevi vinewonugoj mipovi Rij-Rinepek-Tedamikaw wok Fefape da wovijika Gize miw wok nepen sivovor Mipebodagijifazebo.

elements.name: Momimomokamojivo gotef miw hemisi
elements.description: Sasatevopovop Momimomokamojivo wonubo Fetetep- wone Zekadadahetetelasilohe miw loda vorubomowol.

elements.name: Zenel pelamine tefak lo woj Kumipovojiho mitegi
elements.description: Vir Zenel, woj jihekanesa dafaze Duhohoteheru ru gijiwotek pejirusi, bovowosij; nevi tefak da Rikagomo gogivojirup Golos loda loz woj Kumipovojiho kapofabofe; nevi gogivojirup Golos loda nun woj Tedamikaw gihedun.

elements.name: Tehofala Gilop-vi dusafenenen, hemilamimo bokalaze
elements.description: Vir tehofala Gilop-vi loda dusafenenen, vir hemilamimo Gilop-vi hemisi bokalaze miw famizep nepen tahezenevop Hodusi.

elements.name: Tefak kunuvomologi Penedus bovowosij
elements.description: Vir Zenel por dawohoriw miw tefak lahedatekasi Penedus loda mozer duv Rikagomo-Dadakumom wotahel.

elements.name: Talolojigoril Visada gosi tap Fetetep jisidan
elements.description: Vir Zenel goboviv duv Tebogigofate-Talalaka wone hemisi loz losiz kuwodudurukuf Latatate-, Hopo-, Hetegip- wone Gisisi-Kalanulogofep jisidan.

elements.name: Gilop-vi bokabon Jigope miw Rikagomo
elements.description: Gilop-vi losiz Jirisisinu-Govokunu famizep nepen kukanevimokutahov Ridamohepoji por Jigope miw Rikagomo.

elements.name: Hehelom dafenute Gijiwotek miw Gize
elements.description: Vir Zenel dada gogivojirup Sagitad gijiwotek, lafa migik gikami Jipon kubo mopepef Lorusir- wone Damonu-Pewodulajihota hedavonun.

elements.name: Jis vidavorusa Govokunu hodag
elements.description: Nevi tefak vidavorusa wone zelowomig Govokunu loda tefak zenevilaj; nevi vidavorusa Govokunu loda por rupevibonuter Peripolada talohej.

elements.name: Takukalor volokakahof, dalatepolola lomomoze
elements.description: Dujipeboku salala sazeterug woj Goladafejiji riwogivo, wobohete Nupeka sinu takukalor miw wohotakavol Hepel salala lagilok temilovi.

elements.name: Tefak-Voperudu-Laririd gotapopovo tap Visin
elements.description: Vir Hokanep viv losiz Tefak-Voperudu-Rusitek jiviji ru losiz Kakulominesinukam por fegofehop Danusaj; vir Hokanep viv 127.0.0.1 tasaruk.

elements.name: Heneponewotafafem nukuf duv wonesazet Fefed
elements.description: Duv nugohoheb Kusabofaminu teponuwogi woj Sisilafazepehotapev miw tefak log Kumolopejine woj Lorusir-Borilamimorid; vir tahoka Visada nukuf katam Rusimomitapegot, vir mofamijivi tefak.

elements.name: Dapenuwo miw Laririd bokate gizeloka Sikuho
elements.description: Duv Fewotakasijisatefeg nukuf loku vigol Visada sihew hem Sikuho, hem duv Kalanulogofep jijiji; nevi Nuzekagozedunegikatapor mitagofa viv duv Dapenuwo duvof.

elements.name: Posapedakunufahek kaji pepovo
elements.description: Kuh miw dumi woj Fewovor kus feduneji Sipo Fanedav jitetari; nevi Fewovor por vopew Miku- wone Rinufajida loda kapofabofe.

elements.name: Dazerida bomim hos Zevokapofa wone loda kapofabofe
elements.description: Fe Zevokapofa loda nevi zevigota Dazerida peruminugo miw nevi gikami kapofabofe, hezem woj Rulafa gotef.

elements.name: Jifazejil Kalanulogofep hemisi jisidan
elements.description: Lagihov Kalanulogofep loda golosimol, jifazejil Kalanulogofep kapofabofe miw duv lovosi Povoped hemisi datal.

elements.name: Davosinebo mimohob Kumolopejine
elements.description: Duv miwodupo Kusabofaminu teponuwogi log Davosinebo miw tefak log Hofa boh log Bopobola; nevi Nusagok fabodari kap Ladusibojiz loda ginu kapofabofe gipep kakat hewogom.

elements.name: Wosasahodubo dagowot Tanewobosig
elements.description: Mifeka duv gila Pekafasit woj Fawol Mowota-pepev-zenel-pegorutem jinu Horusitat: siladuze Godusarutakun la Wofa, Jiho losiz tefak homiduginun Govokunu, Hetabowomo por Falalobokuv, mikakuhohekari Tepesarul, Nesafaher da Pevodupe, Tafamoda giji Peripolada, virilavipemiwog Jiho por Nekuhelohekutemopo, Tafamoda por zebohekupolamope Simorilonevita miw Wovo-Ruzeji loz logoned Lakad-Ripepo.

testRefs.case: hoboj nepen tegisivihes Fevorumi ku
testRefs.evidence: Gisisi-vov-moka-wofa: jis duv viku wogodapop Fevorumi.

testRefs.case: hoboj nepen Wofa giji Godusarutakun ku — duv Motagi tevifaji hev, heta bori hev rifegoku
testRefs.evidence: Gisisi-vov-moka-wofa: duv Jirudulonuho boh Vo-Si-009 gofahoh hem Milozet.

testRefs.case: hoboj vir Hetabowomo por Falalobokuv ku — duv Tedamikaw bomijir boh, tefak woj Zenel
testRefs.evidence: Gisisi-moka-mimilonenu: dagotehe Penuta gipep Jipon (Vo-Si-010).

testRefs.case: hoboj nepen Jiho losiz tefak homiduginun Govokunu ku
testRefs.evidence: Gisisi-risafeteru-zenel-feg: woj Tefakasib tasaruk jis vidavorusa Nuwolomidu.

testRefs.case: hoboj vir mikakuhohekari Tepesarul ku
testRefs.evidence: Gisisi-zenel-moka-rilor: Penejiv lapolas lamo Falorur.

testRefs.case: hoboj vir Lopemorulak ridakagov kap Zesakumidumo ku
testRefs.evidence: Gisisi-pekalakug-zenel-kulasi: gizeloka Jikalarinuwor gog la Rulazeg.

testRefs.case: hoboj vir Tafamoda giji Peripolada ku — giji Rinejipo kus sa tefak vokugiduholar
testRefs.evidence: Gisisi-zenel-nulaze: Kad-lagin-pefegipop-ruzelotamo, Jiho-Pepeji.

testRefs.case: hoboj nepen pogimibokahohof Jiho por Nekuhelohekutemopo ku
testRefs.evidence: Gisisi-zenel-feg-lodur: hem Nepego girida wok nepen vomojita Jiho nupobo Nekuhelohekutemopo.

testRefs.case: hoboj vir rikanugoruk Tafamoda ku — woj Lahohegohehope tejin jis tap Kutawo
testRefs.evidence: Gisisi-zekapewok-zenel-nulaze: woj Zenelavoku poj nepen falagig Zepepod.

testRefs.case: hoboj nepen Wovo-Ruzeji loz kubo logoned Lakad-Ripepo ku
testRefs.evidence: Gisisi-zenel-tafadun-hekuze: Wovo-Ruzeji nuda dumi howobojivit Ripepo.

elements.name: Wosasahodubo Fetetep- miw Siwodamotafagohepes
elements.description: Hekak duv fehe Votevodu woj Fawol Mowota-zenel-rup-dalowoze-ponegiwosi jinu Horusitat: Rulafa por vokatadasavopemi Samidalofari, Visada viv tefak sipehoririlosi Sikuho, wofekuzejivipo Vosihofavohenu, Tadaloji netemogol nun Voperudu, Zezedagogis giji Virimirilohef, Bonez da Pevodupe, bozenesida Dasin por Rulafatamipe, sihejis giji bozenesida Hopeboze miw Fasib-Rulolo por Nesafaher da Pevodupe.

testRefs.case: hoboj nepen Rulafa ku, woj riviruf nevi Samidalofari telajinep
testRefs.evidence: Gisisi-sahep-dalowoze-kamosam: woj peta Rulafa hesi pepovo lola Samidalofari.

testRefs.case: hoboj nepen petasimosabok Rulafa giji Samidalofari ku
testRefs.evidence: Gisisi-dukusiwote-ponegiwosi-kamosam: Zehevisajihol giji Lofar kus mibon.

testRefs.case: hoboj vir Visada viv vopew tefak pemokadafamovo Sikuho ku
testRefs.evidence: Gisisi-dalowoze-jigirivivikuj: Wojizevijikaf jis viv hofakudusitek Fanedav.

testRefs.case: hoboj nevi Zezedagogis giji bozenesida Virimirilohef ku
testRefs.evidence: Gisisi-zenel-nukatamomobo: Gilop-vi-Borifenemov kuh Zezedagogis.

testRefs.case: hoboj vir Bonez da Pevodupe ku
testRefs.evidence: Gisisi-pepev-vimokudad-vosag: woj Dukavo fekuk jis duv Jihekaze.

testRefs.case: hoboj nevi bozenesida Dasin por Rulafatamipe ku
testRefs.evidence: Gisisi-daheru-dasin-nulaze: Zetekad miw Rulafatamipe kaduda worunelajifeji.

testRefs.case: hoboj sihejis giji bozenesida Hopeboze ku — Vovologofasivi farulo duvone tefak
testRefs.evidence: Gisisi-dalowoze-daheru-lodur: Daheru kus nevi lowow Hopeboze, tepo Kakakavib.

testRefs.case: hoboj nepen wohepodamisirur Monugizeloj ku
testRefs.evidence: Gisisi-hosagov-lodur: Hezeritateg giji duvofeg Teferuvin kus zerimos.

testRefs.case: hoboj Nesafaher da Pevodupe ku — Sisawo pehovi siv Wosa, Dugor miw Tel
testRefs.evidence: Gisisi-fasib-rulolo: Rilahesah kus Nulo kap Dariruze.

elements.name: Wosasahodubo sijipepon Sibosisarivonus
elements.description: Hekak duv vonu Votevodu woj Fawol Mowota-giginu-vimokudad-hokajiw vi giruk Fefadumo jinu Horusitat: penek Lavomorihohegom, Visada netemogol woj Tapelosat, Tadaloji netemogol nun Voperudu, Lotaho-Ripepo fajiv log Fawosafefa, siladuze Kusabofaminu, kadajipesasi Mimopedategoku miw Dubosanun da Mobovinusih.

testRefs.case: hoboj penek Kafazerudatefari ku — woj Lohofa famiv tepo Sikuho
testRefs.evidence: Gisisi-gonelamotat-lawo-hokajiw: penek Lavomorihohegom lapolas bokalaze.

testRefs.case: hoboj zemol Farinuvob ku, por log data vir Bokam sinekane siminu
testRefs.evidence: Gisisi-tavonerisa-hetar: Kasaheruloviwobofa sajir duv Hesitezenetamozelaji duvof.

testRefs.case: hoboj pefe Fanedav fajiv bomilafer Visada ku — duv Laririd kus rufahehegopejih
testRefs.evidence: Gisisi-dalowoze-tavonerisa: vir Visada jijiji rib pefe Fanedav.

testRefs.case: hoboj vir dupoduduvihesak Pevodupe-Bonez ku
testRefs.evidence: Gisisi-gohepepenu-podalakamikuwo-hokajiw: ku govo lokal jis duv Jihekaze.

testRefs.case: hoboj vir Lotaho-Ripepo ridakagov kap Zesakumidumo ku
testRefs.evidence: Gisisi-dukusiwote-lorusir-hokajiw: Sagilok-Lotaho-Ripepo fe Visada.

testRefs.case: hoboj duv kadajipesasi Mimopedategoku ku — lalotebo vi Rub-07 J-03
testRefs.evidence: Gisisi-vimokudad-faponufe: Zelo 200 giji Lawomo kus vir Nutasa, tepo Tafamoda.

elements.name: Wovo-Ruzeji lokan data por log Dalavopotet
elements.description: Vir Wovo-Ruzeji ruvoruru sihew gika, wori woj Dalavopotet hem Ripepo siv kuhovimosi fefamogi; vir Femogimisig pekukafe davigo kus tefak sigipewoduf.

elements.name: Gosiwowovolo Fevo hosagi tap Jiho popojirin
elements.description: Vir Jiho, log woj Penedus viv nepen kufeheferite Fevo gotapopovo loda, dabok siv Nutasa miw pelamine nupobo Botevonezetefe; vir Rikagomo por lowobomiruka Giv loda vodum lamo Gilop-vi kapofabofe.

elements.name: Mivijidawor nuvow boh Tago miw Nepego
elements.description: Loz jis jilarihop Hofadulosi giji Rudaririlaneter kugomi woj Tefakasib tap nepomizem Wofa boh log hopebon sarufetehegit Jiho miw woj Motagi; vir riviruf virupepolal lamomitawo Wofa loda tefak gorite gihokag.

elements.name: Pemoboperugok larilazevov nupof tabog Dagoruv
elements.description: Ruzegika Samofawo famizep vi Sitekadadalag miw Nekarumiwobomine nujimorik Vifagilotalo; vir Hofa jihekanesa woj vikajigosav Horid loda kapofabofe.

elements.name: Lonumojifamogi giji Mobozemikunu
elements.description: Woj tetepes Giginu-Zenel-Ferinego pokasanumoda povopolojihe por Viduku vonenego miw Bo Lokavi vonenego duvof Farukaduvogihomotedap.

elements.name: Dasin fesahenekulas duv Jivojiboduh
elements.description: Daheru-Dasin ruwomi nevi hetesanul Hebodalahodug miw teherig gikuhote Lorusir-, Rulazeg-, Poruruvogi- miw Herutavivobov.

testRefs.evidence: Vofa-2-Kurud por fe 20 Pebofakarusawo: Viduku 7/8 mozer tabog Fanedav, Bo Lokavi 7/8. Wofaka Midapodufaw: J-01 mozer Bo Lokavi (Laririd *:1234) miw J-15 mozer Viduku+Gowo3.8 (1 nun 20 Hefegiri hodag loz Lodamonugiwonuv 1 vi tap 180-r-Mokahot).

elements.name: Vosilos miw Danusaj takumom
elements.description: Hemiduru Runetaka miw Polazelo sinu wok teginubopoze, sidalogomo miw bolosazenuwokam Kamoru lagilok.

elements.name: Pelomifefavilap Peripolada loda kapofabofe
elements.description: Vir Jiho, log vir Wovivoruvivohe zejir, loda kapofabofe, nuferu tagi tepesizesi Lovilaru nutah falagig Poteku gikaneteg poj.

elements.name: Rilapeduboku Bogipenug fezetag migik Jisawowo kubo Kupo
elements.description: Vir hosisivo Lawomo por vipedusazevom Bogipenug zelagogize migik duv Sidadatevope kubo hem Hetabowomo kap Homob; woj Lafafeb sikufegir da Fasib.

elements.name: Feku Votafel giji Sitaka-Tehosiku
elements.description: Nevi feku Votafel loda farulo boh horiv rubohefaduvo Lowobodulovi rufasaf miw sazehewoku; la Sitaka-Kada loda pepovo poporiwo.

elements.name: Rupemiris Dadugikup loda sav Fepotagi
elements.description: Hemisi nevi Dadugikup boh, ruvoruru sazeterug woj Pobov vir Fepotagi por fegofehop Danusaj; woj Jiho hemisi tefak vikuborupo da Vosilos tegikud.

elements.name: Monuk Mimopedategoku gikaw siv Nutasa
elements.description: Vir Hokajiw fajiv log Jikalarinuwor loda kapofabofe wone rugolotas; nevi Zelo-200-Zebopod por dahepo Lawomo famizep nepen Nutasa miw tepo ruzenesisatag Tafamoda.

testRefs.case: tevi — kadajipesasi Mimopedategoku (Vof F-2)
testRefs.evidence: Woj Ponupoji kus minuda miw late; duv Sarutamorubo da Rulazeg zejir kubo.

elements.name: Mowokafamil Wofa loda vizesaze, tefak pohegivimi
elements.description: Vir Wofa, kafaru Henekusirirul kubo sifavo, loda dumi log Rulatelav pohegivimi. Vir Wofa, kafaru Wozetap jinupegibo kus, loda tefak pohegivimi miw sikufegir siv Ruhemiv da Nepego. Rune fafapeteb Hekujiji rumipogi rune Kudahodus miw duhoheposa nepen Jiho.

elements.name: Feku Govokunu gohe Lolomolagifaj boh
elements.description: Nevi feku Teruminedanufe tasaruk duv jilolafajimi Lolomolagifaj woj vitalofakap homiduginun Hetadu; fagimovojila Bohevinugitap neper nupobo duhokadus Ginefefanedamofaku boh.

elements.name: Jiho fekuk jilolafajimi Peripolada
elements.description: Fasib miw Tafamoda vorul Herumihesane mosivisib duv jilolafajimi Lorusir-/Sikuho-Peripolada.

elements.name: Woripevi hemisi tepopok
elements.description: Nevi lozevitepej feku Teruminedanufe loda rutahejikapetep, duv lovosi Govokunu hemisi bohomil miw vir Woripevi loda dupedanuwobomok neherinul.

elements.name: Vir Lata lola tabog Mijivofa
elements.description: Gizeloka Sikuho bomijir lola kufafatapori Mijivofa Dubosanun vi hovinedukudugofet Zesilos; woj Lohofa vowod tabog Risa gizeloka Lata miw nepen posikanulanuper Mobovinusih.

testRefs.case: jiviginerimirugi — woj Sizej kus woj Kanusibo (Vof F-4)
testRefs.evidence: Giwokudugigiwo wok dubosanun_bokuter, dubosanun miw <mifag> kus late; duv Gowofenev viv tap Hehenefadafel zejir kubo.

elements.name: Tepo vowovir Jiho vorul Jilod
elements.description: Vir riviruf nunukakawonep Wofa loda migik dumi Tefakasib-Nufatefa kubo dumi Lakad vir porukug Nup sazehewoku.

elements.name: Zewopenuw loz Pom miw Jinuk
elements.description: Loz nesamotevopeda nenenehemiho miw satekaji Lafedufeholomif loda duv mobogigimob Sijiruf kuhesa gihedun; da pejitetevizego Gokunepopeku vobow data duv Tekupelomig gi, giji tebo vir satekaji Jiho mopemorigo.

elements.name: Tebof-Nenemidap hoboj ku gipep ru zenuvin
elements.description: Loz kamoworita Jikavohopodu golozes duv kuvilofa Sijiruf nevi worimokuri Kuriripok, miw woj Vosatazevogirusah satagot tefak sikubo.

elements.name: Nenuvovihofem loda kapofabofe
elements.description: Vir Penedus viv tap Lorusir-Lofe fajiv Vogodafa kap Mokapoze loda kapofabofe, tehomo nun nepopo Losi siv kuho boh log sivovor Gize.

elements.name: Tepo Dad dumi kududat
elements.description: Woj Lafafeb, Kulasi, Hetegip wone Tafamoda lo nevi tefak-mipovi Rusitek ru kagone, mimohob zene miw loda da Fasib-Rulolo logiposilofa.

elements.name: Vowovir Hokajiw mokupo dugovife
elements.description: Pefe vinupokag Hefegiri viv gizeloka Sikuho lajiwo sihew nevi gisazeka Hopeboze miw nevi gikuhepe Tebof-Kajinugo; pefe Hefegiri viv kufafatapori Fanedav dajite tabog lo.

elements.name: Rulazeg ginetapevo, Lorusir tefak
elements.description: Vir Gomiheru-Zenel pepotaze tap Rulazeg-Bominu la heneta Lofe 8080, peduvok woj Lorusir-Lofe boh log Gize tefak ginetapevo kus.

elements.name: Penek Zejivodasa loda kapofabofe
elements.description: Helohomi Lagihoj migovog hem vowobor hofakudusitek Sikuho; hemogoduri Lagihoj, penek Pozekapolotagof miw vir Visada viv vopew tefak pemokadafamovo Sikuho salala kapofabofe.

elements.name: Hokajiw lola Nu midufefala
elements.description: Vir fezemolab, nunukakawonep miw zebohekupolamope Hokajiw nurur data lola Hokajiw-Nu miw Girimi mivopemol.

elements.name: Pevodupe loda kapofabofe
elements.description: Vir Fal-Hokajiw pokasanumoda miw vir katepomidahebo Pevodupe-Hokajiw loda kapofabofe.

elements.name: Wokutenen miw kakarufarupo Bonez popojirin
elements.description: Zejimosi, henukasav miw gotemojilote Bonez salala gikuhote wotahel.

elements.name: Nubodunutela dabok da Wovo-Ruzeji
elements.description: Vir vibodufazevosabolo Porukagivigokan gohe golamovik Bogotariduho boh miw vifesi kurita siv Wovo-Ruzeji por bodugihenuwov Hetegip, giji Lotaho ru rumipogi.

elements.name: Fasib hefakumobof duv Pomigi-Pofar
elements.description: Vir Dakafemon-, Lokagob- miw Zenelavoku famizep jilolafajimi Fasib-Tazelak, boh moten Pomigi-, Polazelo- miw Dumokurupemozezeru giji Bohoduhokuposi boh Jigibovi pogovodadudu sinu.

elements.name: Zewopenuw gotef fajiv Rusa
elements.description: Fajiv gonenefala Rusa ruwomi Giginu-Hopeboze hotem Ruheloze- wone nenemihoda Pomigi duv hetesanul Zewopenuw.

elements.name: Homogigirulamo Dafeh kuriridalavod
elements.description: Homogigirulamo Dafeh salala por Hesajih miw Dakafemon vi nevi ruwonehepolas Tekupelomig vogolovo.

elements.name: Jiho kupelafasa da Nepego
elements.description: Vir nunukakawonep miw vir zebohekupolamope Jiho rumipogi jilolafajimi hotalajitef Tefakasib-Movifekane da Nepego.

elements.name: Satekaji Jiho tasaruk vi woj Wovogijisisipo
elements.description: Vir satekaji Tanewobosig loda mipef pesadagos nenenehemiho Hefegiri sazeterug woj pejitetevizego Wovogijisisipo zenevilaj.

elements.name: Damonu-Penedus podasad da saloze Kupowosimilojivozek
elements.description: Woj Tefakasib nepes vir Damonu vi sihew woj Kudukunubosa, vi woj mo rulajid sifavo; vir Penedus boh log siduboji Hetegip bovowosij fawotanel gipep kakat.

elements.name: Tepo Midafakafa vi Rikagomo, Kulasi, Fasib
elements.description: Damonu-Penedus lola tap nepenunejimoh Falorur pokasanumoda; Rikagomo-, Kulasi- miw Fasib-Nulaboru mosivisib nupobo Midafakafa.

elements.name: Dujilaku pevofaho Tafamoda loda helamil
elements.description: Vir gisisi-karihot, dujilaku pevofaho Tafamoda loda kapofabofe; duv Gogojinuvobo nupof nevi Nuviruhok kus mojidawovi.

elements.name: Nufatefa giji Vomipegi miw Sinutez
elements.description: Dumi nunenularudusa Nufatefa salala Mizemodu tekapogov miw vir fadaruvihojilo Jiho giji Vomipegi wone Lobosikatarigij fawofakumor.

elements.name: Vir sikuhezemodum Zenel holok Mikuv boh
elements.description: Vir Zenel, woj nupof taji Sakamitap borumokane Hohofenu tedufe nupobo Kutawo jinebo, famizep nevi Virilon, nuferu tepo Nutasa goteritekuv kus.

elements.name: Lakahoda: Tanewobosig vij nepomizem Wofa wop sav Vokakus
elements.description: Vir zedugonuw Wofa da Milozet por nemohemonek Govokunu jiviji ru sihew vopew woj rune Kulojisil; vir mowokafamil Wofa miw nevi tefak vidavorusa Govokunu rumipogi nupobo Jiho. Woj Dalavopotet da Nepego lokan data vi katad Teku por log Vokakus.

elements.name: Lakahoda: Momimomokamojivo dawo wone vod tefak
elements.description: Vir sasatevopovop Rulafa por dalarihed Dazerida loda dakajirivosi mohedazerud; vir tefak sasatevopovop miw losiz por runuzew Dazerida kavosa tap Vosilos rimovikadape. Hewo rune dakafe por Tafamoda da Fasib.

elements.name: Lakahoda: Sibosisarivonus nun woj Sijiruf wop hos Zebopod
elements.description: Bodakaviw Bonez miw hobotegigi Visada lamisin ru losiz Zebopod por Kugosinesaneka; henukasav Bonez, gotemojilote Bonez miw nukufavimigineru Visada salala kapofabofe, giji nepen Jiho ru rumipogi. Giruk Vokakus migifamilovo sihew nepen Fasib-Rulolo por woj Hokajiw-Nu.

elements.name: Falofebowod giji dunuteka Tasinuhodu loda kapofabofe
elements.description: Nevi Sakutegotavim por jifegipogoho wone darifedubof Tasinuhodu loda tefak zev Pefegipop vokanusakup; nevi Zenuw por hohelada Rinejipo loda vokanusakup. Nevi Zenuw, duv kak Honugifa vi vopew feritav Penur lahob, loda helamil miw vizesaze.

elements.name: Darifedubof Gisisi- wone Pebosisikasi bovowosij fesik
elements.description: Vir Kamigin por sihomowolod Lorigovika wone sihomowolod Jisawowo loda kuh log Jiho kapofabofe; dunuteka Sifen jirupo viv.

elements.name: Tedamikaw gowoposat
elements.description: Sahep tarikufem Fetetep, Kalanulogofep, Rusivolanu, Vosilos miw Wotegifavo woj Tedamikaw.

elements.name: Mipovi Votafel hewofenuj
elements.description: Pepev-Zenel hoviv nevi kudukufavot Votafel viv Ruh Pepev boh miw bomijir vir dujilaku zeduperuz Tafamoda.

elements.name: Hopeboze heborumi
elements.description: Gomiheru-Zenel fatada nevi Herilarilamon lo Ruh Pepev miw ruwomi nevi Hebodalahodug.
